AC-S4-28.1.detail: An answer is called verified only if the host verified every step; the best-verified of several candidates is kept; a fabricated excerpt never reaches a verified answer in any depth.

AC-S4-28.2.reason: Whether best-of-n raises the share of fully verified answers for the 7B model must be measured with the model on the owner's machine; the threshold (e.g. +X points of verified answers over a single attempt on held-out questions) awaits owner approval (Q-S4-01). The engine and its guarantees are proven above with scripted candidates, not with the model.
